text: You walk out of the big supermarket with a ham you did not pay for. Nobody stops you. Yet.

up.label: Become the ham bandit

risk.result: CCTV. Very clear. You looked into the camera.

text: Your accountant suggests a 'creative' tax trick. He's wearing a hat indoors. Two hats.

up.label: Go full offshore

risk.result: The audit letter is very polite and very long.

text: A neighbour's hedge is 2 cm onto your side. You have a ruler, a grudge, and a free weekend.

up.label: Trim it at 3 a.m. in a balaclava

risk.result: Doorbell camera. Balaclava did not help.

text: A tabloid calls you 'the most hated person on the street'. The street is very long.

up.label: Lean all the way in

risk.result: Your gran reads tabloids. Your gran has thoughts.

text: An old friend asks you to hold a bag for a week. It's heavy and it ticks. Only slightly.

up.label: Hand it to the police

risk.result: Your friend finds out who called.

text: A crew in a back room wants a driver for one big job. The plan is drawn on a napkin.

up.label: Redraw the plan on a better napkin

risk.result: The crew's leader takes credit for your napkin.

text: The night of the job. The van smells of crisps. Someone forgot the masks, and the plan.

up.label: Swap the loot for the hospital's bills

risk.result: The crew is not thrilled with your edit.

text: The heist crew is in court. Their lawyer is your cousin. He has only ever done wills.

up.label: Write the book about it

risk.result: The crew reads it in prison. They all have notes.

text: A streaming service wants a documentary about 'your controversies'. They have a whiteboard.

up.label: Give them total access

risk.result: Total access includes your group chats.

text: The documentary airs. It's called 'Monster?' The question mark is doing a lot of work.

up.label: Do the press tour and own every mistake

risk.result: One host only asks about your teeth.

text: The documentary gets a sequel. It's called 'Monster? Part Two: Actually Quite Fine'.

up.label: Make it about the people you hurt

risk.result: Not everyone wants to be on camera. You respect that.

text: Three bars in town have your photo behind the counter. Not in a nice way. One is laminated.

up.label: Apologise to each bar, with flowers

risk.result: One bar keeps the flowers and the photo.

text: Your mugshot is a meme. You look like a disappointed horse. There is merch now, too.

right.label: Buy a mug of your mugshot

up.label: Sell your own merch for victims' charities

risk.result: The horse jokes never stop.

text: A hate group says you're 'one of them' because of your record. You are absolutely not.

up.label: Volunteer for the people they hate

risk.result: They send hate mail. You frame the spelling mistakes.

text: Your lawyer bills in six-minute chunks. Your hello cost $40. His hello cost $80.

up.label: Study law yourself at night

risk.result: You fall asleep in torts. Twice.

text: Your parole officer is your old PE teacher. He still calls you by your surname. Loudly.

up.label: Turn up early with a job offer

risk.result: He makes you do a lap anyway.

text: A film studio wants you to play a villain. 'You have the face for it,' they say, kindly.

up.label: Play it so well it wins awards

risk.result: Critics say you weren't acting.

text: You make a 'most wanted' list. You're number nine, behind a man who steals garden gnomes.

up.label: Hand yourself in with every gnome

risk.result: The gnome man is furious you stole his thing.

text: A school asks you to speak about the worst choices of your life. They have a 40-minute slot.

up.label: Mentor the kid in the back row

risk.result: The kid is exactly you. It's a lot.

text: Your sibling changes their surname so nobody links them to you. They picked 'Smith'. Bold.

up.label: Spend a year earning it back

risk.result: They still go by Smith. They do answer your calls.

text: Your crimes are taught in a criminology class. Students call you 'the case study'. Respectfully.

up.label: Guest lecture on why it wasn't worth it

risk.result: A student asks for tips. You give them a reading list.
